paper.title: Receivables: WorkMind run, subsequent receipts
paper.objective: Trace year-end receivable balances to receipts after the year end.
paper.procedure: For each balance above the threshold, the run matched subsequent bank receipts to invoices and listed the unmatched remainder.
paper.population_sample: 412 receivable balances; 388 matched to receipts; 24 unmatched, listed by customer.
paper.result: Unmatched balances total 1,120,000.00 across 24 customers; the largest is 310,000.00.
